task: Worked the DEFINITE (8) and DISCUSS (~11) sections of design-docs/plans/active/final_release/audits/test_value_audit_2026-07-10_engines.md — deleted tests providing no fixable value, fixed tests whose underlying scenario was worth testing but was mocked-out/self-referential/vacuous, left precedent-backed or genuinely-real timing tests as-is. No production code changed.

tests/bridge/test_bridge_registry.py.summary: Deleted test_voice_bridge_rejects_unknown_engine (DEFINITE #1): it mocked RemoteBridgeHandler.synthesize itself to fabricate an 'Unknown voice engine' EngineRequestError that no production code ever raises. Traced the real path: VoiceBridge.synthesize delegates to RemoteBridgeHandler.synthesize with zero added logic; the only real upstream validation (bridge_utils.extract_engine_id) only rejects a MISSING engine_id, not an unknown-but-present one — an unknown engine_id passes that check and only fails downstream via the TTS Server's HTTP 404, which bridge_remote.py translates to EngineUnavailableError, not EngineRequestError. No real 'unknown engine id' validation path exists to test, matching the audit's own delete fallback. test_voice_bridge_describes_remote_registry_by_default (DISCUSS) left unchanged — it calls real create_voice_bridge()/describe_registry().

plugins/tts_xtts/tests/test_inference_lo.summary: DEFINITE #2: replaced all 3 self-referential tests (test_xtts_inference_guard_raises_on_missing_voice, test_xtts_inference_main_key_and_fallback_consistency, test_synthesize_one_logic_routing — each reimplemented xtts_inference.py's nested _synthesize_one logic and asserted it against itself) with 3 tests that call the REAL module-level _run_synthesis_loop(...) (which owns the nested _synthesize_one closure) with mocked tts/xtts_model collaborators: guard-raises-with-no-latents-and-no-speaker_wav, prefers-precomputed-latents-over-fallback, falls-back-to-speaker_wav-when-no-latents. No production refactor needed — _run_synthesis_loop was already module-level/importable. R1 revert-checked all 3 (temporarily neutered the guard and the latents-vs-fallback branch in xtts_inference.py; each new test failed for the right reason; restored via Edit, not git checkout). Kept test_xtts_stderr_status_lines_flush_in_order (confirmed REAL) in place.

tests/engines/test_xtts_segment_grouping.summary: DEFINITE #5: rewrote test_handle_xtts_segments_uses_get_text_chunk_limit — it previously never called handle_xtts_segments (mocked get_text_chunk_limit then manually re-called the same mock and fed it into build_segment_groups directly). Now calls the real handle_xtts_segments(...) with a real Job, real get_chapter_segments/generate_via_bridge patched only at the boundary, and app.engines.behavior.get_text_chunk_limit patched to 100, asserting the captured `script=` kwarg passed to generate_via_bridge has 2 (not 1) entries. Confirmed non-redundant with the adjacent test_segments_split_when_limit_is_100 (that one exercises build_segment_groups directly/in isolation; this one proves handle_xtts_segments actually threads ctx.get_text_chunk_limit through end-to-end). R1 revert-checked (hardcoded sent_char_limit=500 in segments.py; test failed for the right reason; restored via Edit).

tests/engines/test_plugin_loader.py.summary: DEFINITE #6: rewrote test_xtts_manifest_and_schema_contains_model_v2 to route through the real discover_plugins(PLUGINS_DIR) loader path (finds the loaded xtts LoadedPlugin, asserts on its .manifest/.settings_schema — the same dicts the production loader parses and exposes) instead of independently re-reading manifest.json/settings_schema.json off disk. plugins/tts_xtts/tests/test_warm_worker..summary: DISCUSS item (R4 sleep smell): test_idle_timeout_kills_worker replaced its blind `time.sleep(2.5)` wait for the real threading.Timer-driven idle timeout with a poll-until-condition loop (deadline + 0.05s poll interval, checking the real worker-alive state each iteration) — same real behavior under test, no fixed blind wait.

plugins/tts_xtts/tests/test_xtts_timing..summary: DISCUSS item (R4 sleep smell): test_xtts_adapter_timing_payload_contains_raw_anchors_and_segments replaced its two `time.sleep(0.01)` calls (used only to force distinguishable render_started_at/render_completed_at timestamps) with a deterministic, strictly-increasing fake time.time() (itertools.count) patched for the duration of the real plugin.synthesize(req) call — same real code path (engine.py's parse_output), no wall-clock wait, and not coupled to an exact call-count (unlike a fixed side_effect list).
